newsitem.title: UK: BOC profits rise despite strong pound.
newsitem.headline: BOC profits rise despite strong pound.

text.p: Health and industrial gases specialist BOC Group Plc on Thursday reported a two percent rise in first-quarter pre-tax profit, despite the negative impact of the pound's strength versus other currencies.

Pre-tax profit rose to 102.7 million pounds ($166.1 million) from 100.8 million, meeting analysts' expectations. Profit would have been seven percent higher if currency effects were excluded, BOC said.
"We have made a satisfactory start to the year with the underlying performance of each business well up to our expectations," chief executive Danny Rosenkranz said in a statement.
Operating profit in the gases business rose two percent with results increasing in Europe as well as the South Pacific and Asia.

The troubled healthcare business saw profits fall slightly, but results would have been flat if currency translation effects were ignored. The sector continued to be hit by lower prices for its anaesthetic gas Forane.
Operating profit in the vacuum business, which specialises in machinery for super-cleaning semi-conductor factories, dropped 13 percent as expected following a sharp fall in order intake, BOC said.
